attachment.evidence: POST /api/qualification/session/open returned status=open sessionOpen=true pid=<selected> targetBounds=765x503 within ~2s; the injected library logged '[RemoteInput] GetNativeReflector: entered' then 'reflection created' and /dev/shm contained RemoteInput_<pid>, RemoteInput_ControlCenter_SyncSignal_<pid>, sem.RemoteInput_ControlCenter_EventRead_<pid>, and sem.RemoteInput_ControlCenter_EventWrite_<pid>

build.evidence: focused input/qualification tests 149/149 (junit-focused/); ordinary suite 2510 tests, 99 failures, 0 errors, 14 skipped; replay 280 tests, 12 failures; base/candidate deltas against integration base 1f1b6b5da792e6d611b648fc11219d893b5dcd7c show no story-attributable introduced failure identity; see ../verification-evidence.md

capture.evidence: POST /api/qualification/capture returned 765x503 frames with freshness NEW then PAUSED, stable content timestamps, and no error; captures stayed bounded and none were committed

debugger.evidence: GET /debugger returned 200 and ss showed only 127.0.0.1:8090 bound (loopback-only)

discovery.evidence: GET /api/windows returned exactly the intended RuneLite/Micro6 client pid for the single-client runs and both pids in deterministic order for the two-client run; wrappers, Gradle daemons, IDE JVMs, and launcher agents were excluded

input.evidence: bounded mouse move succeeded, out-of-bounds move returned HTTP 400, a LEFT click and a 65 key press both reported held state false afterwards, and GET /input/held confirmed nothing remained held

multiClientIsolation.evidence: two eligible clients were listed deterministically; with one session open on the first client, explicit selection of the second attached only to that pid and closed cleanly, then re-selection of the first attached back to it; no first-match fallback

recording.evidence: out of scope for this story (packaging/recording follow-up)

release.evidence: POST /api/qualification/session/close returned status=closed within milliseconds, a second close returned the documented SESSION_CLOSED terminal state, and GET /input/held showed nothing held

remoteLaunch.evidence: not exercised; the client was launched directly on the host for qualification

repeatedAttachment.evidence: three open/capture/close cycles after the restart-fencing attach each completed in ~0.3s wall time with no growing delay, no leaked rendezvous objects beyond the documented per-pid set, and no poisoned state

resizeMinimize.evidence: the selected main frame was resized to 900x600, iconified, and restored via Xlib while attached; captures remained bounded at 765x503 with PAUSED freshness, no error, and no selection migration

targetRestart.evidence: after the attached client exited, session/open failed closed with 409 TARGET_EXITED for the stale selection; a restarted client produced a new linux:<pid>:<ticks> identity and attached successfully after rediscovery. During one cold-start race the host-side inject call timed out while the in-target probe completed afterwards, producing TARGET_ALREADY_ATTACHED on retry instead of a double injection; a warm restart attached cleanly

targetSelection.evidence: POST /api/windows/select then GET /api/windows/current returned the same linux:<pid>:<ticks> id; preflight selected the same pid
